first_step_test: One broad open bowl outline fixes the scale, tilt, and attachment gap for the handle; a beginner can copy it before adding any detail.

final_elements.name: spoon bowl
final_elements.description: Draw a wide tilted oval bowl at the upper left, leaving a narrow gap at its lower-right edge for the handle.

final_elements.name: spoon handle
final_elements.description: From the two open bowl ends, draw two gently converging lines toward the lower right and round their tip.

final_elements.name: inner bowl
final_elements.description: Inside the bowl, echo its oval with a shallow inner curve, keeping the rim narrowest where the handle joins.

final_elements.name: wood grain
final_elements.description: Add three short curved grain lines along the handle and two small crescent marks inside the bowl.

final_elements.name: cast shadow
final_elements.description: Put a broken cast shadow just below the bowl and handle, leaving white paper between shadow and outer contour.
